ios.name: Anacan: Pregnancy & Baby
ios.subtitle: Period, Ovulation & AI Tracker
ios.promotional_text: New: “Messages from My Baby” — your baby sends you a sweet message every day! Partner mode, 8 weeks of postpartum support and 21 languages. Now in Anacan.
ios.description:
Anacan is every woman's closest friend: a period tracker, pregnancy week by week, baby care and the Anacan.AI assistant in one app. With 30+ helpful tools, a warm community and partner mode, we're with you at every stage.

PERIOD & OVULATION
• Smart period calendar and next cycle prediction
• Ovulation and fertile days
• Symptom, mood and daily logs
• Late and irregular period alerts
• Pill reminder

PREGNANCY WEEK BY WEEK
• Your baby's development every day, with fruit size comparisons
• Daily tips and help preparing questions for your doctor
• Kick counter and contraction timer
• Hospital bag, shopping list and baby names
• Weight, blood pressure and blood sugar trackers
• Pregnancy album
• “Messages from My Baby”: your baby sends you a sweet message every day, and you write back. Share the chat as an image or video!

MOTHERHOOD & BABY CARE
• Feeding, sleep and diaper logs
• Height and weight growth charts
• Vaccination schedule
• Solid foods guide (from 6 months)
• Teething, sleep training and developmental milestones
• White noise, bedtime stories and help understanding your baby's cries
• Postpartum recovery and mood check (EPDS)

ANACAN.AI — WITH YOU 24/7
Ask anything, day or night: pregnancy, feeding, baby sleep and more. Answers are tailored to your stage.

PARTNER MODE
Invite your partner: they follow the pregnancy too, get daily missions, and join the birth plan and night shifts. For 8 weeks after birth, we show them step by step how to support you. You decide what to share.

SUPPORT IN SENSITIVE MOMENTS
After a pregnancy loss, Anacan stops notifications right away and offers a gentle 8-week recovery guide.

COMMUNITY
Ask questions, share experiences and find support in groups with thousands of moms.

21 LANGUAGES
Available in Azerbaijani, Turkish, Russian, English, Kazakh, Uzbek, Georgian, German, Arabic, Chinese, Indonesian, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Vietnamese, Hindi, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Dutch and Swedish.

ANACAN PREMIUM
Premium unlocks Anacan.AI, partner mode and unlimited access to all tools. Choose a monthly or yearly subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase, and the subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://anacan.az/terms
Privacy Policy: https://anacan.az/privacy

Anacan does not replace medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Always consult your doctor about decisions regarding your health.
